classes.name: Shield Thane
classes.subtitle: The Unyielding Hearth-Wall
classes.description: Armored vanguard sworn to the high holds. Master of the locked shield-wall, sweeping waraxes, and front-line resilience.

classFeatures.name: Wall of Iron
classFeatures.desc: +2 Armour Class while carrying a shield in your off-hand.

classFeatures.name: Shield Slam
classFeatures.desc: Batter your adversary: 1d6 damage and stuns them for 1 turn (once per combat, 1 Stamina).

classFeatures.name: Warrior's Second Wind
classFeatures.desc: Catch your breath amidst blood and snow: restore 2d6+2 Health (once per fight, 2 Stamina).

classes.name: Rime Scout
classes.subtitle: Silent Path of the Bow
classes.description: Stealthy stalker of the taiga and jagged crags. Expert archer who tracks wolf packs and snipes from snowdrifts.

classFeatures.name: Ghost of the Drift
classFeatures.desc: +2 on Tracking and Survival checks; +1 bonus to ranged attack rolls.

classFeatures.name: Crippling Arrow
classFeatures.desc: Pin your quarry to the frozen ground: deals ranged damage and entangles for 2 rounds (1 Stamina).

classFeatures.name: Snow Blindness Immunity
classFeatures.desc: You read the glare of sun on snow without faltering; night and blizzard penalties are halved.

classes.name: Skald Spellblade
classes.subtitle: Song, Steel and Rime
classes.description: Warrior-poet trained in the ancestral chants of Frostmere. Weaves frosty evocations around tempered steel.

classFeatures.name: Rime Blade
classFeatures.desc: Your weapon strikes hum with bitter chill: +1 frost damage on all melee hits.

classFeatures.name: Glacial Blast
classFeatures.desc: Release a freezing cone of rime: 1d8 frost damage and weakens the foe for 2 rounds (1 Stamina).

classFeatures.name: Hearth Chant
classFeatures.desc: Inspiring verses steel your spirit: +2 Maximum Morale and +2 vs fear effects.

classes.name: Shadow Prowler
classes.subtitle: Lockpick and Poisoned Stiletto
classes.description: Infiltrator from the Mistglen canals. Disables deadly crypt traps, bypasses bronze vault locks, and strikes from shadows.

classFeatures.name: Nimble Hands
classFeatures.desc: +3 bonus on lockpicking and pickpocketing actions; lockpicks never break on failed attempts.

classFeatures.name: Blinding Powder
classFeatures.desc: Flung powdered ash into enemy eyes: confuses target for 2 rounds (1 Stamina).

classFeatures.name: Backstab Mastery
classFeatures.desc: Exploit unguarded vulnerabilities: +2 damage on attacks against stunned, confused, or entangled targets.
